body: PERPENTACH, the Laughing Man, the mad mind-mage king, leader of the Balseraphs in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; man; looks about forty though centuries old; lean and wiry, with long restless fingers. A pale, sharp-featured face, wild black hair streaked with silver, gold-flecked eyes.
costume: a harlequin doublet of gold and crimson diamonds under a purple-and-crimson velvet cape trimmed in gold, and a tall pleated white ruff.
signature: His smiling white porcelain CARNIVAL MASK, one black tear painted under its eye, is always with him, pushed up on his forehead or in his hand.

vibes.name: The Punchline
vibes.line: his right forefinger pressed to his lips to hold the pause, his left hand dangling a crowned marionette from its control bar; head cocked, eyebrows high, a grin about to burst, glittering eyes searching the viewer's face; his palace theatre stage at night, a hard white spotlight overhead.
vibes.wears: the stage king's harlequin doublet of gold and crimson diamonds, a tall pleated white ruff and a purple velvet cape trimmed in gold.

vibes.name: Swallowed Minds
vibes.line: fingertips of both hands pressed to his temples as if tuning many voices at once; a soft rapt smile, eyes unfocused past the viewer, listening; the court inside his own mind, a hall without walls in timeless grey-violet half-light, pale faces of every age crowding around his head.
vibes.wears: a long patchwork robe sewn from scraps of many people's clothes, a farmer's brown homespun, a soldier's red, a priest's white, a child's blue, no two patches alike.

vibes.name: Mask Under Mask
vibes.line: his right hand lowering the porcelain mask from his face, his left hand pulling a curtain aside; beneath, his own face painted to match the mask: gold and crimson harlequin diamonds over one half of it and a single painted black tear under one eye, his real mouth closed in a small, knowing smile; eyes straight on the viewer; a candlelit masked ball at midnight.
vibes.wears: a masked-ball costume of black-and-silver brocade: a long fitted coat, a black domino cape, silver diamonds down the sleeves.

vibes.name: Flying Cows
vibes.line: both hands clapping together at his chest like a delighted child, a grin splitting his face, eyes following a cow sailing in a high arc from his catapult over the enemy walls; a siege camp on a hill at bright blue noon.
vibes.wears: a mock general's sky-blue velvet coat with absurdly huge gold epaulettes, a sash pinned with tin medals, and a tall plumed helmet hung with little bells.
